## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Node labels from the shared module — every node carries P35.29's `label` +
   `label_basis`; no UUID, connector key or source id is ever a node label
   (L-2 / SIG-UI-D20 as an export-level test); organisations render per ADR-159
   (matched → label; unmatched → the typed `not_yet_reviewed` state; persons and
   withheld entities get no node).
2. Edge evidence fields (SIG-EXPORT-D21 draft) — every emitted edge carries
   `predicate` (words, not a raw slot name), `observed_at` + `date_kind` (with
   `undated` first-class — a 1970 placeholder renders "undated", never
   1970-01-01), `source` (display name, never the raw id), `currency` class, and
   `claim_ids` for the evidence trail; the `WEAKLY_SUPPORTED`/`evidence_count: 1`
   constants come out (computed from the claim set).
3. Degree as a node attribute — `sharing_partner_degree` claims are node
   attributes ("shared with N … partners not named"), never drawable edges
   (SIG-INGEST-043c / H-4 / D29).
4. Historical marking — edges whose valid time has ended or whose currency is
   historical carry the H-2/H-3 marking (visibly historical, out of
   present-tense statements).
5. Literal-twin edges — the partner-literal claims that today stay in
   `sharing_edges.csv` join the emitted edge set where the publishable-edge
   rules admit them (person-shaped literals never become nodes — Part VIII).
6. Copy correction — the "deterministic ER … exact" claim stays removed; what
   the graph shows is stated at its real epistemic posture (SIG-IDENT-030).
7. No new JavaScript — the richer JSON renders through the existing island and
   its no-JS fallback at the current ceiling.
8. Tests: fixture edges carry all five evidence fields; a 1970 placeholder
   renders "undated"; a withheld organisation renders the typed state; degree
   facts are node attributes and never edge rows; the emitted JSON validates
   against the page's consumption contract; island budget unchanged.
9. Requirement stamps in the PR body: F-106, F-420, F-421 + cited ids
   (SIG-EXPORT-D21 recorded as the draft id).

## Plan

- `reconcile.materialize.read_materialized_edges` — additive: also return
  `observed_at` and `upper(valid_period)` (`valid_to`) so the export renders real
  temporal bounds; the full evidence-claim set is not persisted on the row, so
  the export rejoins the publishable sharing-edge claims by
  (from, to, access_kind).
- `exports.spine_export` EXPORT_QUERIES — add `claim_lineage` (guarded on the
  `claim_lineage` table, degrades to honest absence on a pre-P35.25 spine) so a
  claim's declared independence class is available; the existing `claim_weights`
  read already carries claim → source/predicate/observed_at.
- `_network` / `_network_from_materialized` — shared `_edge_evidence` helper:
  group the publishable sharing-edge claims by (subject, partner, access_kind),
  collect `claim_ids`/`sources`/earliest `observed_at`, compute `support` from
  the declared independence classes (≥ 2 distinct declared classes →
  STRONGLY_SUPPORTED; ≥ 1 claim → WEAKLY_SUPPORTED; never CONFIRMED at this
  layer), `currency` via `reconcile.weight.currency` (C1–C4 → CURRENT/AGING/
  STALE/HISTORICAL; `UNDATED` when no evidenced date; `null` when the predicate
  is unregistered), `predicate`/`relation` in words (never the raw slot name),
  `date_kind` ∈ {observed, undated} with the 1970-01-01 epoch rendered undated,
  `historical` = ended bound or HISTORICAL currency. Literal partners emit
  person-screened literal nodes; person-shaped literals and withheld entities
  never become nodes (the edge drops). Degree predicates become node
  attributes (`degree` + `degree_claim_ids`/`degree_sources`), never edges.
- `web/src/lib/network.ts` — `NetworkEdge`/`NetworkNode` gain the optional new
  fields (additive; pre-P35.30 artifacts still parse) + a pure
  `edgeTemporalText`/date-kind wording helper used by the static page (server
  side — no island weight change).
- `web/src/lib/data.ts` — `getNetwork` keeps its parse contract; new fields pass
  through (the schema doc gains the optional fields).
- `web/src/pages/network.astro` — edge rows show date+kind, source, currency and
  the historical/undated marking (H-2/H-3); a "Recorded partner counts" block
  renders degree attributes; no island or script change.
- `docs/build/reports/public_surface_contracts.schema.json` — additive optional
  fields on `NetworkEdge`/`NetworkNode` documenting the extended contract.
- ADR-216 — the owned decisions (literal-twin admission + person screening,
  degree-as-attribute, the support-floor rule, date_kind vocabulary, currency
  classes incl. `UNDATED`).
- CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry (public-behaviour change: network.json shape).

## Test matrix

| AC | test |
|---|---|
| evidence fields | materialized + fallback fixture edges carry predicate/observed_at+date_kind/source(s)/currency/claim_ids, all from fixture data (never constants) |
| undated | a `1970-01-01` claim and a null-date claim both emit `date_kind: "undated"`, no epoch date |
| withheld/person | a denied/person entity → no node, no edge; a person-shaped literal partner → edge withheld; review-pending org → `label_state: not_yet_reviewed` node |
| degree | `sharing_partner_degree` claim → node `degree` attribute; no edge with that predicate (D29) |
| literal twins | a literal partner claim joins the edge set with its name node; entity-ref twins match the materialized edge's claim set |
| historical | an ended / HISTORICAL-currency edge carries `historical: true` |
| support floor | two declared-independent claims → STRONGLY_SUPPORTED; one claim → WEAKLY_SUPPORTED |
| L-2/D20 | no node label matches UUID / connector-key / source-id patterns |
| contract | emitted network validates the (extended) schema; label_basis in the closed vocabulary |
| web | unit tests for the new rendering helpers + fields; island budget unchanged |
